data.title: Generic Input Capture via API Hooking
data.summary: The sample hooks or polls input APIs to capture everything typed or entered through standard UI controls, not only keystrokes — form fields, password-masked inputs, and GUI dialog content.
data.description:
This is broader than keylogging: it covers hooking at the window-message or accessibility-
API level, which captures input regardless of which keylogging technique (if any) also
runs, including content entered into password-masked fields that never generates a
standard WM_KEYDOWN the keyboard hook would see. It is frequently paired with a specific
target list — banking portals, password managers — rather than capturing indiscriminately.
data.recommendation:
* Enumerate installed window and accessibility hooks (SetWindowsHookEx chain, UI Automation subscribers) rather than assuming keyboard-only capture.
* Rotate credentials for any application whose input the sample's target list or captured buffer references.
* Deploy input-capture detections at the API level (hook installation, accessibility-API subscription) rather than relying solely on keylogger-specific signatures.
data.short_recommendation: Enumerate installed window and accessibility hooks rather than assuming keyboard-only capture.

mitre_techniques.procedure: Installed a window-message hook and an accessibility-API subscription targeting known banking-portal window classes.

mbc_techniques.implementation: Subscribed to UI Automation events to capture form-field content independent of the keyboard hook.
